art_direction.identity: A calm, numerate residential property manager: mineral blue-gray canvas, navy ink, one brass accent, dusk architecture photography with softly rounded corners, and navy bands for the process and footer.
art_direction.type: Bricolage Grotesque for every heading, number and the wordmark (medium weight, tight tracking); Geist for body and interface text at 1rem with a relaxed line height. Money and counts always use tabular numerals.
art_direction.color: Mineral canvas and near-white surface, ink text in two tiers (ink, muted), hairline lines. One accent: primary (brass) only for the main button, the statement's net line, and the day markers. Text on primary uses primary-foreground (ink). Never add a second accent.
art_direction.signature: The owner statement (sections/statement) — a sample monthly statement typeset like a real ledger, with dotted leaders from each line item to its amount, laid over the hero photograph. Its lines come from site.statement and site.statement_lines. Keep it in the hero wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Plain, numerate and calm. Say what happens and when, in numbers where possible. No superlatives, no exclamation points, no promises about returns.
